models_evaluated: AI/ML CBC-based colorectal cancer risk model

links.outcome: Follow-up screening uptake among patients flagged high-risk by the model after outreach
links.effect: 62 high-risk participants identified and contacted; only 4 returned for further testing and 1 agreed to colonoscopy, limiting model validation.
links.quote: However, only four participants returned for further testing, and just one agreed to a colonoscopy.

unlisted_practices: Using mSEPT9 blood biomarker as a less invasive alternative follow-up screening for AI-flagged high-risk patients

screen.reason: Pilot deployment identifying high-risk patients from EHR data and attempting patient outreach/follow-up screening, without evaluating a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
